summary: Senior 3D Character Artist with professional experience creating real-time characters and assets for games. Former Lead 3D Character Artist at Gameplay Galaxy, with hands-on work across sculpting, anatomy, garment creation, grooming, retopology, UVs, PBR texturing and engine integration. Experienced in leading artists, organizing production workflows and adapting visual quality to technical requirements.

bullets: Led and mentored the character-art team while remaining directly involved in production.
Created game-ready characters across sculpting, garment creation, grooming, retopology, UVs and PBR texturing.
Collaborated with concept, animation and engineering throughout character production and integration.
Modeled and textured characters, props and environments for in-game use.
Supported rigging, integration and generalist workflows for prototypes and indie productions.
Delivered custom 3D assets for international clients across games, AR/VR and animation.
Adapted assets to different visual styles, production needs and target platforms.
Promoted from 3D Generalist to Lead after approximately three months with the company.
Worked across modeling, texturing, rigging, animation and game-engine integration.
Led artists and helped organize production workflows while remaining hands-on with 3D delivery.
